remarks: Great opportunity to own this bright and sunny totally remodeled 1- bedroom, 1-bathroom condo in the desirable Village Walk complex. Newer A/C, energy efficient appliances, kitchen cabinets and counters, floors and freshly painted. This pristine unit absolutely sparkles with all the updates and includes an extra 9 X 20 locked storage space accessible via basement. The grounds are beautifully landscaped and maintained and the fabulous outdoor pool is a must for the warm summer months. Stroll into Wilton Town Center for great restaurants, shopping and the library. Location is perfect as you have Schenck's Park across the street and the Norwalk River Trail minutes away. Enjoy an effortless one floor living experience for those who value convenience and in-town living. This turnkey and special place to call Wilton your home will not last!!
